selection_rule: Highest mean of Y3S1 and Y3S2 validation mean_mastery_change on the common scenario bank (Y3S1 seeds 81000+episode, Y3S2 seeds 82000+episode), shared by every candidate. Ties use the lowest seed. The held-out bank is not used.
acceptance_rule: On validation only, the selected seed must have invalid_action_rate mean 0 in both semesters, and mean_mastery_change at least the lowest of weakest_practice, recent_performance and weakest_multi on that same split. Passing is not real-student validation and does not by itself switch the live app. Failing leaves activation_allowed false.
training_schedule: Every seed alternates episodes: even index Y3S1, odd index Y3S2. Separate single-semester seeds are not combined training.
